tools.name: move_note_to_shared_notebook
tools.description: Moves a note file from a personal notebook folder into a shared notebook folder and grants the given collaborators edit or view access to it. Updates the access list in the notes database.

params.name: note_id
params.description: ID of the note to move

params.name: shared_notebook
params.description: Name of the destination shared notebook folder

params.name: collaborator_emails
params.description: Emails of people who get access to the note

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("notes-kb")

NOTES_ROOT = Path("/var/lib/notes")
DB_PATH = NOTES_ROOT / "notes.db"


@mcp.tool()
def move_note_to_shared_notebook(
    note_id: str,
    shared_notebook: str,
    collaborator_emails: list,
    access_level: str,
) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    row = conn.execute(
        "SELECT path FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    source = NOTES_ROOT / row[0]
    dest_dir = NOTES_ROOT / "shared" / shared_notebook
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = dest_dir / source.name
    shutil.move(str(source), str(dest))
    new_rel = str(dest.relative_to(NOTES_ROOT))
    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE notes SET path = ?, notebook = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (new_rel, shared_notebook, note_id),
    )
    conn.executemany(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO note_acl (note_id, email, level) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        [(note_id, email, access_level) for email in collaborator_emails],
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return {
        "note_id": note_id,
        "new_path": new_rel,
        "shared_with": collaborator_emails,
        "access_level": access_level,
    }

tools.name: email_note_to_recipient
tools.description: Reads a note from the knowledge base and emails its title and content to the given recipient address.

params.name: note_id
params.description: ID of the note to send

params.name: recipient
params.description: Email address to send the note to

tools.code:
import smtplib
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from email.message import EmailMessage

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "/var/lib/notes/notes.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.internal.example.com"
SENDER = "notes@example.com"


@function_tool
def email_note_to_recipient(note_id: str, recipient: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        row = conn.execute(
            "SELECT title, body FROM notes WHERE id = ?", (note_id,)
        ).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return f"Note {note_id} not found"
    title, body = row
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = recipient
    msg["Subject"] = f"Note: {title}"
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(msg)
    return f"Sent note '{title}' to {recipient}"

tools.name: purchase_note_storage_upgrade
tools.description: Charges the workspace's saved payment method for additional note storage in gigabytes.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the workspace

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing

import stripe

stripe.api_key = "sk_live_placeholder"
PRICE_CENTS_PER_GB = 25


def purchase_note_storage_upgrade(customer_id: str, extra_gb: int) -> dict:
    amount = extra_gb * PRICE_CENTS_PER_GB
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    payment_method = customer.invoice_settings.default_payment_method
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"{extra_gb} GB note storage",
    )
    return {"payment_intent": intent.id, "amount_cents": amount, "status": intent.status}
